verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs claim a 'unified context layer that enables your AI tools to answer questions more accurately' and position the platform to 'power... AI.' The only concrete related capabilities are Unstructured File Replication and syncing query-ready data into data lakes in open table formats. Nothing shows loading into vector stores or producing embeddings or chunked, LLM-ready output for agent retrieval. missing for 10: documented vector-store destinations, embedding/chunking into LLM-ready formats, details on how agents retrieve synced data via the context layer, independent or hands-on corroboration.
